intelligence.essence: Six locked directives for the membership system — including the big one: login codes go through Smart Mail, not email.
intelligence.human_view:
1. **Login codes via Smart Mail, NOT email.** The membership system syncs with Smart Mail. Email is opt-in only: the user enters their email and chooses notifications (e.g. "send my login codes to email"). The simplest path never touches email at all.
2. **"Create membership" buttons = the most beautiful buttons ever.** They are the doorway to the citizen's income — they must feel like it.
3. **Gating:** membership creation requires Pro or Max tier. A non-Pro/Max citizen who clicks "Create membership" goes to the upgrade flow; once Pro/Max, creation unlocks.
4. **Payments stay simple:** Stripe/PayPal, automatic on Power/Pro/Max upgrade.
5. **Smart Scheduler on every page:** must be built, aligned with the booking app — one shared calendar system, different scheduling functions (appointments, posts, mail, messages, reminders, journal).
6. **Sync engine MUST be completed:** Smart Lists + Smart Connections + Messenger all talk to each other. Lists feed the messenger, the messenger feeds the scheduler.
intelligence.simple_view: Your secret login codes arrive in your Smart Mail — the mailbox inside NayaNET — not in ordinary email. And the button that creates a membership, the doorway to your income, has to be the most beautiful button ever made.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, your secret codes come to your own private mailbox inside the system — no fishing through cluttered email. The button that opens your membership is made beautiful, like the door of a fine shop, because it's the doorway to your livelihood. Everything important is kept in one tidy, synced place.
intelligence.naya_view: I run memberships on Smart Mail: login codes through Smart Mail by default, email strictly opt-in. Creation is gated to Pro/Max with an upgrade path, payments stay simple (Stripe/PayPal on tier upgrade), the Scheduler is one shared calendar on every page, and the sync engine — Lists, Connections, Messenger talking — is a must-complete, not a nice-to-have.
intelligence.ai_view: Each directive removes a dependency on the old internet: no email for login, no ugly buttons for the money doorway, no paywall confusion, no separate scheduler app, no disconnected lists. One system, one source, everything synced.
